✨What does it cost an American to visit Algeria? 🇩🇿 • The Backpacker Budget: $30 – $45 / day. (Staying in local guesthouses, taking overnight trains, and eating fresh street markets). • The Adventure Traveler: $80 – $140 / day. (Hiring a mandatory certified local guide to legally explore the ancient Roman ruins and nomadic Saharan towns). • The Luxury Tier: $200+ / day. (Staying in high-end international hotels in Algiers and booking private domestic flights across the desert). ✨Flights from the US run anywhere from $850 to $1,600 depending on the season.
